title: Sisters: whispered warning and shouted reply

turns.speaker: Narrator
turns.text: The hallway was dark and quiet. Mira said,

turns.speaker: Mira
turns.text: "Stay close and keep your voice down."

turns.speaker: Mara
turns.text: "I can hear footsteps behind that door!"

turns.speaker: Narrator
turns.text: The door closed softly. They waited together until the final bell rang.
